title: GAME_CHOOSE_ABILITY system prompt instruction too terse for weak models
description:
MiniMx M2.5 tried `choice="no"` on GAME_CHOOSE_ABILITY prompts twice (lines 101 and 340 of MiniMx Proud_pilot.log), getting: 'GAME_CHOOSE_ABILITY requires index=N.' The model did not learn from the first failure.

The system prompt (puppeteer/prompts/default.md line 43) says only:
  `- **GAME_CHOOSE_ABILITY (index):** Pick an ability with choice="0".`

This is ambiguous because:
1. Other action types accept choice="yes"/"no" — the model confuses the formats
2. It doesn't mention calling get_action_choices first
3. The contrast between index-based and boolean-based choices is not explicit

Suggested fix: Expand the instruction to:
  `- **GAME_CHOOSE_ABILITY (index):** You must provide a numeric index. Use choice="0", choice="1", etc. Do NOT use yes/no — those won't work here.`

This is a toolset mismatch issue — minimax-m2.5 is consistently confused by this tool interface. If the expanded prompt doesn't help, consider adding GAME_CHOOSE_ABILITY to the auto-handled list for weak models.

Evidence:
- ~/.mage-bench/logs/game_20260302_005956_g4/MiniMx Proud_pilot.log lines 101, 340
- puppeteer/prompts/default.md line 43
- Mage.Client.Bridge/src/main/java/mage/client/bridge/BridgeCallbackHandler.java lines 1881-1901
